叶片和短舱为原创教学几何，拆解位移为展示排布。流点与伪彩色表示路径和温度，不表示: Blades and nacelle are original teaching geometry. Exploded offsets are exhibition layouts. Tracers and false colours illustrate paths and temperature, not measured particles, flames or gas velocity.
喷管把气流剩余的压强能和热能转成速度。核心喷流和外涵道喷流分开排出。若收敛喷管达: Nozzles convert remaining pressure and thermal energy into speed. Core and bypass jets exit separately. At the critical pressure ratio, a convergent nozzle chokes and exit pressure also contributes thrust.

沿着发动机走一圈：风扇分流，压气机增压，燃烧室加热，涡轮取走轴功，喷管把剩余能量: Follow the engine: fan splits the flow, compressor raises pressure, combustor adds heat, turbines extract shaft work, and nozzles accelerate air. Select parts or zoom inside.

虚构的双轴分流涡扇；零维稳态循环，非任何型号的工程模型。未求解叶片流场、冷却引气: Fictional two-spool turbofan; a 0-D steady-state cycle, not an engineering model of a product. No blade flow field, cooling bleed, surge, fixed-area matching or start-up dynamics are solved. Mass flow and RPM follow the documented reference schedules.
试着增大涵道比。更多空气由低压涡轮带动的风扇加速，同时需要更多轴功。: Increase bypass ratio. The LP-turbine-driven fan accelerates more air and requires more shaft power.
轴功按能量平衡匹配，包含 99% 机械效率。: Shaft power is energy-balanced, including 99% mechanical efficiency.
这个组合没有足够的核心喷管压差。它超出了本参照循环的可行工况。: This combination lacks sufficient core-nozzle pressure difference. It lies outside the feasible range of this reference cycle.
降低压气机效率：达到相同压比需要更多轴功，出口也更热。观察高压涡轮必须取走多少能: Reduce compressor efficiency. The same pressure ratio needs more work and gives a hotter exit. Watch how much energy the HP turbine must extract.
高温气体先经过高压涡轮，驱动压气机；再经过低压涡轮，驱动风扇。两根同心轴允许两套: Hot gas first drives the HP turbine and compressor, then the LP turbine and fan. Concentric shafts permit different speeds. Gas total temperature and pressure fall as turbines extract work.
按相等逐级压比分配总温升，非叶片流场求解。: Temperature rise is allocated using equal stage pressure ratios; no blade flow field is solved.
